rules.statement: The obligation to transfer property and the corresponding right of retransfer can be assigned, unless the obligations of the other party are personal in nature.
rules.supporting_quote: "Obligations are impersonal where the law considers that the personality or identity of the person in whose favour they are to be performed is a matter of indifference to the performing party. Where the obligation is impersonal the corresponding right is assignable."

meta.parties: Muhaneiram Et Al. v. Salam Et Al
